methodology: The initial 985-recipe technical-reviewable set was divided into actual breakfast/oat, lunch and snack ingredient/method matrices. Every recipe variant was accounted for through its exact ingredients, quantities, protein state, cooking format, flavour components, storage and final serving metadata. The reviewer independently read the lunch module authored by a separate agent and its concrete output across all 464 descendants, including all protein and dressing combinations. The 32 simple breakfasts were read individually. Repeated method templates were reviewed once with every differing ingredient variant; this is not physical cooking or tasting. Author-written 271 breakfast/oat repairs are not self-approved here; they require separately attributed root review.

review_basis.title: Actual listed ingredients and food format support the displayed dish; corrected misleading fruit/vegetable labels and explicit Creamy Cheddar dressing revisions checked.
review_basis.ingredients: Every measured ingredient has a use; ready-to-eat cooked proteins, drained canned pulses/sweetcorn, edible fruit, dry grains, measured oil and defined dressing components checked.
review_basis.method: Bread/side-salad distribution, actual sandwich toasting, jacket-potato doneness, rice/pasta/couscous cooking and protein-specific preparation checked across 464 lunch descendants. Breakfast egg seasoning and cherry edible fruit corrections checked.
review_basis.equipment: Method-required appliances, bowls, cutting, draining and heatproof vessels checked; no unavailable appliance is essential to the stated method.
review_basis.allergens: Aggregate known-ingredient allergens checked for egg, gluten, milk, fish, soya, mustard and relevant bought sauces. No allergy-free guarantee or unverified brand exclusion is made.
review_basis.nutrition: Independent Decimal arithmetic from original quantities and exact primary CoFID rows; generic products and explicitly disclosed proxies remain estimates. Raw/cooked source-state mismatches were corrected in the additive pack and independently checked; all five nutrient fields recalculated.
review_basis.storage: 24-hour refrigerated window and shorter use-by precedence checked; rice cooled ideally within one hour; toasted already-cooked filling has exactly one reheating step; cold lunch components remain chilled.
review_basis.food_safety: Actual method accounts for fully set egg, ready-cooked animal protein, safe chilled assembly, cooked grain handling and removal of inedible fruit parts.
review_basis.serving_metadata: One-serving quantities include all sides; total times equal prep+cook+rest and are explicitly estimates. Rice and jacket-potato timings accommodate the actual method; overnight soaking is separately counted in authored oat rows.

resolved_findings.description: Explicit ready-to-eat protein states and all listed oil/dressing ingredients; actual toasting and jacket cooking; side salads retain excess filling quantities; rice chilling and toastie single-reheat instructions.
Opaque mustard mayo, Caesar and smoked-paprika dressings replaced with measured ingredients, known allergens and recalculated nutrition; Caesar display names corrected to Creamy Cheddar.

Authoring performed by /root/medicine_baselines, independently reviewed only by the separately attributed root reviewer. Fifty-one missing-liquid oats gain 210 ml milk for 70 g oats using the Dairy UK published 3 ml/g baseline.
Measured black pepper explicitly used in eight egg-toast recipes; two basic cherry recipes remove stones before weighing; simple equipment lists completed.
Additive raw trimmed bacon, explicit raw turkey breast mince proxy, dried egg noodles, raw peeled roast potatoes and cooked-weight plain oven chips corrected; 798 accepted entries remain unchanged.

independent_arithmetic.basis: Separate Python Decimal parser uses original explicit gram weights, governed teaspoon/count/oil-density conversions, and exact primary CoFID values; rounds only final per-serving totals to nearest 0.1. Source mapping suitability assessed separately by actual recipe editorial review.

external_review_sources.methodology: Four formats (102 each), six protein identities and seventeen flavour labels. All ingredient/amount combinations and actual distinct cooking instructions were read; equal templates were compared across every descendant, including salmon, minced meat and tofu.
